 The United States Coast Guard (USCG) Long Range Enforcer Product Line (LREPL) has a service acquisition contract for repair services for the AN/SPS-75 Air Search Radar System. These services are essential to maintaining the radar system in a fully mission-capable status, ensuring operational readiness and reliability for critical air search and detection functions. The vendor will be responsible for disassembly, inspection, condition and test reporting, repairs, reassembly, testing, preservation, packaging, packing, and marking of the AN/SPS-75 Air Search Radar System. Northern Defense Industries, LLC (NDI) is the only U.S. authorized repair vendor that provides this service for the critical radar components.
